description: This file defines the interface for interacting with Xfinity Battery Backup (XBB) devices, including enums, structs, and function prototypes for status retrieval, configuration, discovery, alarms, and siren control.

methods.name: xbbIsBatteryPaired
methods.description: Checks if a battery is currently paired.

methods.name: xbbGetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status information from the XBB.

methods.name: xbbSetConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options on the XBB.

methods.name: xbbDiscover
methods.description: Attempts to locate the XBB device.

methods.name: xbbGetAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of alarms from the XBB.

methods.name: xbbSirenStart
methods.description: Starts the siren with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: xbbSirenMute
methods.description: Mutes the bad battery siren for 24 hours or until the next daily window.
